title: Carbon Emissions of Ride-hailing Industry and Proposal to Transit Industry to Electric Vehicles
what_it_is: Carbon Emissions of Ride-hailing Industry and Proposal to Transit Industry to Electric Vehicles

sections.label: Ride-hail fleet carbon emissions
sections.summary: Singapore's ride-hailing industry emitted about 0.3 million tonnes of carbon in 2020, and companies committed to a cleaner energy fleet by 2040.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2020, the ride-hailing industry in Singapore generated an estimated 0.3 million tonnes of carbon emission when performing ride-hail trips.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: This is about 4% of the estimated seven million tonnes of carbon emission generated by the land transport sector.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Under the Land Transport Master Plan 2040, our taxi and private hire car companies have committed to make their entire fleet run on cleaner energy by 2040, and operators such as ComfortDelGro and Grab have been adding electric vehicles to their fleets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Transport and Land Transport Authority will continue to work with our industry partners to transition the entire ride-hail fleet to cleaner energy vehicles.

sections.label: Point-to-point sector cleaner energy shift
sections.summary: Point-to-point operators committed to cleaner energy vehicles by 2040 and have progressively replaced internal combustion engine vehicles, with taxi cleaner energy shares rising.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have noted in my reply, the point-to-point or, PHC sector operators have already committed to convert their entire fleet to cleaner energy vehicles by 2040.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And indeed, they have been progressively replacing their internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, for instance, for the taxi operators, between January 2018 and January of this year, the proportion of cleaner energy vehicles, hybrid as well as electric vehicles have actually increased from about 18% to close to 60%; about 59-odd percent.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And for the point-to-point sector, the proportion has actually increased from about 20% over the same period to about 35%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, they are progressively doing that and we will work closely with them in the transition to cleaner energy vehicles.
